results.title: Periodic H2 synthesis for spacecraft attitude control with magnetorquers and reaction wheels
results.abstract: Particularly attractive for small satellites, the use of magnetic torquers for attitude control is still a difficult problem. Indeed, equations are naturally time-varying and suffers from controllability issues. In this paper, a generic model, taking different kinds of pointing and different kinds of actuators into account, is proposed, linearized and then discretized. Recent studies d...
